instruction: Implement EVERY card in this pack. Clone from clone_path; match effect_text. Use duel_helpers.h. Spells: only edit the listed .c file. Activated/permanent may need monster_effects.h / dispatcher — serialize those. Do not leave TODO bodies. One make at the end of the whole batch.

cards.effect_text: When you take damage from opponent monster effect, inflict same to opponent. When you take damage from the effect of a monster your opponent controls, inflict the same amount of damage to your opponent.

Mill 2; negate attack on Lightsworn. When a Lightsworn monster you control is targeted for an attack: You can send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the Graveyard, then target the attacking monster; negate the attack.

Coin: lock opp or your NS/Flip. During your opponent's Standby Phase, toss a coin. Heads: Your opponent cannot Normal Summon or Flip Summon until the End Phase. Tails: You cannot Normal Summon or Flip Summon during your next turn.
